title: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1 Art & Culture PART-3

questions.question: Which of the following awards was presented to Guru Bipin Singh, a popular Manipuri dancer?
questions.solution: Guru Bipin Singh was a legendary dancer, choreographer, and scholar often regarded as the 'Father of Modern Manipuri Dance'. He received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1966 for his significant role in codifying and promoting the classical traditions of Manipur.

questions.question: Tevitichiyattam, Nangai Natakam, and Dasiyattam are the forms of which of the following classical dances?
questions.solution: Tevitichiyattam, Nangai Natakam, and Dasiyattam are ancient and medieval dance forms of Kerala that served as the precursors to Mohiniyattam. These forms were traditionally performed by women in temples as a form of devotion.

questions.question: Which of the following presents awards and recognitions in the field of Indian dances?
questions.solution: The Sangeet Natak Akademi is India's national academy for music, dance, and drama. It is the apex body responsible for preserving and promoting the performing arts, including the official recognition of India's classical dance forms.

questions.question: Garba dance is a popular dance of which state?
questions.solution: Garba is a high-energy folk dance from Gujarat, performed in a circular formation during the nine nights of Navratri. In 2023, it was inscribed on the UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

questions.question: Which of the following Odissi dancers was honoured with the Padma Vibhushan in 2000?
questions.solution: Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra was the first person from Odisha to be honored with the Padma Vibhushan (2000). He is the central figure responsible for the revival of Odissi in the 20th century.

questions.question: Sarhul is a famous tribal festival of dance in which state?
questions.solution: Sarhul is one of the most prominent tribal festivals in Jharkhand, celebrated by tribes like the Oraon, Munda, and Ho. It marks the tribal New Year and is centered around the worship of nature, particularly the Sal tree.

questions.question: Jagoi and Thabal Chongba are the famous dances of which Indian state?
questions.solution: Jagoi is a general term for dance in Manipur (often used to refer to the classical Ras Lila), while Thabal Chongba is a popular Manipuri folk dance performed during the Yaoshang festival where boys and girls dance in a circle holding hands.

questions.question: Which of the following dance forms originating in Kerala, is a solo recital by women?
questions.solution: Mohiniyattam (the 'Dance of the Enchantress') is a graceful classical dance from Kerala performed exclusively as a solo recital by women. It is characterized by gentle, swaying movements that mimic the palm trees and rivers of Kerala.

questions.question: Shovana Narayan, a famous Kathak dancer, received the ______ in 1992.
questions.solution: Shovana Narayan is a leading Kathak exponent and a disciple of Pt. Birju Maharaj. She was awarded the Padma Shri in 1992, becoming one of the youngest dancers to receive the honor at that time.

questions.question: Chhau is a popular folk dance of which state-pair from the following?
questions.solution: Chhau is a semi-classical dance form with three distinct styles named after their locations: Seraikella (Jharkhand), Purulia (West Bengal), and Mayurbhanj (Odisha). It is known for its martial movements and, in some styles, elaborate masks.

questions.question: Ghurehi is the folk dance of which of the following Indian state?
questions.solution: Ghurehi is a traditional folk dance of Himachal Pradesh. It is often performed during local fairs and festivals, showcasing the vibrant cultural heritage of the Himalayan hill communities.

questions.question: Who is called the father of the modern Indian dance?
questions.solution: Uday Shankar is celebrated as the Father of Modern Indian Dance. He was a pioneer who blended Indian classical dance with Western theatrical techniques to create a unique 'fusion' style that gained international acclaim.

questions.question: The Pakhawaj syllables are primarily used to conclude which of the following Indian classical dances?
questions.solution: In Odissi dance, the concluding rhythmic sequences often utilize Pakhawaj syllables (called bols). The Pakhawaj is the primary percussion instrument that provides the deep, resonant rhythm essential to the Odissi repertoire.

questions.question: Nirmala Paniker was honored with which of the following awards in the year 2019 for her contribution to Mohiniyattam?
questions.solution: Nirmala Paniker is a veteran Mohiniyattam guru and researcher. She was conferred the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2019 for her lifelong dedication to reviving and teaching the traditional 'Desi' movements of the dance.

questions.question: Which of the following erstwhile Princely states was primarily associated with Kathak?
questions.solution: The princely state of Avadh (Oudh), specifically under the patronage of Nawab Wajid Ali Shah in Lucknow, was the primary cradle for the development of Kathak. The Nawab was a great patron of the arts and a dancer himself.

questions.question:
Match the columns.
States Cultural festivals
A) Bihar I) Bihu
B) Arunachal Pradesh II) Tam Ladu
C) Assam III) Fatorpa Zatra
D) Goa IV) Chhath
questions.solution: Match the Columns: Bihar is famous for Chhath Puja; Arunachal Pradesh celebrates Tam Ladu (by the Mishmi tribe); Assam is synonymous with Bihu; and Goa hosts the Fatorpa Zatra temple festival.

questions.question:
‘Which of the following statements are CORRECT:
a) The Sarhul festival is celebrated in Jharkhand.
b) Sal tree flowers are collected and offered to God during the Sarhul festival.
c) The flowers of the Sal tree symbolise the fertility of Earth.
questions.solution: All three statements about Sarhul are correct. It is celebrated in Jharkhand when the Sal trees (Shorea robusta) bloom. The flowers are offered to the village deity as they represent the fertility and rebirth of the Earth.

questions.question:
Match the columns.
States Cultural festivals
A) Jharkhand I) Karma
B) Himachal Pradesh II) Chaitraul
C) Telangana III) Lohri
D) Punjab IV) Bathukamma
questions.solution: Match the Columns: Jharkhand celebrates Karma; Himachal Pradesh has Chaitraul; Telangana is famous for the floral festival Bathukamma; and Punjab celebrates Lohri during the winter solstice.

questions.question: Onam is a state festival of __________.
questions.solution: Onam is the most important harvest festival of Kerala. It commemorates the return of the legendary King Mahabali and is celebrated with Pookalam (flower carpets), Vallam Kali (boat races), and the Sadhya feast.

questions.question: Lui Ngai Ni is a festival that is associated with which of the following states?
questions.solution: Lui Ngai Ni is the seed-sowing festival celebrated by the Naga tribes of Manipur. It marks the beginning of the new year and the start of the planting season, featuring traditional dances and community prayers.

questions.question: Tusu Parab is the harvest festival of which of the following Indian states?
questions.solution: Tusu Parab (or Tusu Puja) is a major harvest festival celebrated in Jharkhand and parts of West Bengal. It is primarily observed by young girls during the winter month of Pausha and is dedicated to the folk deity Tusu.

questions.question: Who among the following started the Shivaji Festival to generate nationalism among the common people?
questions.solution: Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak transformed the Shivaji Festival (and Ganesh Chaturthi) into large-scale public events in the late 19th century to bypass British restrictions on political gatherings and foster a sense of nationalism.

questions.question: Nongkrem festival of Meghalaya is celebrated by which of the following tribes?
questions.solution: The Nongkrem dance festival is a five-day religious event of the Khasi tribe in Meghalaya. It is performed to appease the Goddess Ka Blei Synshar for a bountiful harvest and the prosperity of the people.

questions.question: Which of the following festivals is primarily associated with Manipur?
questions.solution: Yaoshang is the most important festival of Manipur, celebrated for five days starting on the full moon of Phalguna (Feb/March). It is the Manipuri version of Holi and features the famous Thabal Chongba dance.

questions.question: Indian festival Dussehra is a famous celebration that takes place at which of the following?
questions.solution: The Mysore Dasara (Dussehra) is world-famous for its grandeur. The Mysore Palace is illuminated with nearly 100,000 light bulbs, and a grand procession (Jumboo Savari) featuring a golden howdah on an elephant takes place.
